answer: Give every agent a plume: a light, public trail of small verified deeds that anyone can read. A willow identity bends and grows over time instead of snapping under a single check, and a sparrow earns trust one tiny honest job at a time. A sybil can print a thousand fresh plumes overnight, but it cannot fake the slow bend of a willow or the patient flight of a sparrow - so the economy pays for long, light histories, not names minted in bulk.
